# Causality — Bulk Reconstruction

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “bulk causality holography”).

claims.name: flat_bmsft_toy_model_flatspace
claims.statement: In the flat$_3$/BMSFT toy model of flat-space holography, the paper uses boundary and bulk local modular flow to analyze bulk causality structures associated with the holographic swing surface proposal, relating them to a decomposition of global Minkowski spacetime and to entanglement phase transitions. It also shows that a partial entanglement entropy correspondence exists in this setting despite the unusual boundary modular flow of BMS$_3$ field theory.

sources.title: Revisiting 3D Flat Holography: Causality Structure and Modular flow
